snippet.title: Dino Party - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Get ready for chaotic multiplayer fun with dinosaurs! We are officially announcing our debut title Dino Party - coming early 2026!

Dino Party is a 2–4 player multiplayer party brawler that combines the structure of classic party games with fast, action-based combat. Each match flows through seamless minigames, where intuitive, punchy combat turns every round into chaotic fun.

Wishlist Dino Party on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1939390/Dino_Party/

Join our community and follow the adventure:
Discord: https://discord.gg/TTK93wnRZS
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/studionachtwerk/
Website: https://studionachtwerk.com/dino-party
